content: {"like":["Admiration for directors with high output, like Mr. Mihm.","Preference for high‑quality, reserved tone productions such as BBC Masterpiece Theater.","Enjoys early disaster films using stock footage and model work, e.g., Deluge.","Likes charming family dramas with strong cast performances, e.g., Sarah, Plain & Tall.","Appreciates pulp‑fiction serials with goofy Art Deco aesthetics, e.g., Flash Gordon."],"dislike":["Dislikes films lacking strong scripts and rehearsal, e.g., Destination: Outer Space.","Finds gender‑swap comedy ineffective, e.g., Men dressing up as women stopped being funny.","Dislikes playback issues causing action freeze, e.g., Wheeler & Woolsey collection.","Dislikes sequels that lose original tension, e.g., Sarah, Plain & Tall sequels.","Dislikes comedy that is not uproarious or hilarious, e.g., SILENT MOVIE."]}
